source_record.english: One might ask what things serve as the objects for each of the four divisions of non-virtues just mentioned. The object of the non-virtues of the first division consists of living beings: killing is to take the life of a living being; malice is to feel hatred for a living being; and--as the root text itself says--"harsh speech is that which is unpleasant."
